title: Causa Limeña
description: Causa Limeña is a dish from Peru featuring potato, aji amarillo paste, lime juice, chicken breast. This home-sized recipe records each ingredient at the step where it is used.

steps.instruction: Cook the listed ingredients in simmering water for about 27 minutes until tender; drain well if necessary.
Combine the listed ingredients in a bowl until evenly mixed; avoid overworking delicate components.
Poach the listed ingredients in barely simmering liquid for about 18 minutes until tender and cooked through.
Prepare the filling ingredients: cook or soften any components that require it, let cool, then mix into an even filling.
Layer the previously prepared components evenly inside a baking dish, serving mold or plate appropriate to the recipe; smooth the surface and avoid mixing the layers.
Refrigerate the prepared mixture for about 60 minutes, cooling perishable foods promptly and never holding cooked rice warm at room temperature.
